question: How is the divine lotus visualized in relation to the first octad?
premises: A divine lotus is the object of visualization.
The lotus has eight spokes or petals.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: Therefore, one should visualize a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āra can mean spoke or petal depending on iconographic convention.
